card.name: Digits and symbols in historical or legal citations
card.fires_on: Digits (often 8 or 0), the § sign, or the word clause inside historical dates and legal citations, such as years in ancient history and article or convention numbers.

modes.label: Digits in historical dates
modes.description: A digit inside a year in a history passage, such as a century-old date or an Islamic calendar year.

modes.label: Legal citation parts
modes.description: The § sign, the word clause, or the space before a number in a constitutional or convention citation.
